player.optimizer_voice_rule: optimizer must speak from data only; no assistant preference/opinion spend rules

resource_accounting.relic_core_rule: These relic cores are not a free pile. They are already committed into the current equipped build. A simulator may only count them as available if it explicitly models removing or changing a current forge step and confirms that the game returns that material. Do not mark them as freely spendable by default.
resource_accounting.build_material_mobility_rule: Some materials inside the current build can be moved and some cannot. The optimizer must learn mobility from the sIO/game data or user correction, not assume all are locked or all are free.
resource_accounting.awakening_core_rule: Only awakening cores pullable from other Xeno pet awakening stars are movable. They are not new income and should not be double counted.
